note: assembly_recipe JSON requires schema:2,kind:assembly-recipe,style_id,execution_plan_digest. scope_decision JSON binds style_id and execution_plan_digest; stage approval binds all bytes. Expansion additionally sets sample_contract.source_production_digest to the archived original accepted production stage. The original sample contract remains unchanged. Reuse a valid prior human decision only for exact unchanged stage digest. sample_contract.input_digest describes known preproduction inputs/contract. Do not include a future output hash at H3: H4 separately records sample_inputs evidence and identity.sample_inputs_digest after actual assets and native scene exist. Current asset-routed-visual-sample-v3 production requires explicit asset_proposals and a real assembly recipe with spatial_design_digest and assemblies. Every newly generated mesh in a generated/hybrid proposal must be covered by a validated modeling-reference-package with actual single/multiview image hashes and style/neutral-lighting reviews. No text_to_3d generation. See assembly-recipe-template.json and modeling-reference package template. Current asset-routed-visual-sample-v3 adds scope_mode, baseline-bound sample_space_ids/required_view_ids, required_composition_layers, composition_owners and visual_features. H3 stage also includes actual bom_board and assembly_map image evidence plus production-visual-package JSON. Broader future_backlog is informational and does not block the complete current sample. generated/hybrid routes require real production-ready references, reuse requires approved_reuse, procedural dominant appearance needs rationale plus actual visual evidence. Never use a reference-only or missing design as ready. For S9 expansion, keep the entire original sample_contract unchanged except its existing source_production_digest binding. Set scope_mode=expansion and separately declare production_space_ids/production_view_ids for the current larger recipe. Do not widen the frozen H4 sample just to widen production; use production-expansion-scope-template.json. asset_route_contract=asset-routes-v1 is part of the H3 production-table bytes and stage digest. It cannot be downgraded by relabeling a workflow top-level policy. A scene may mix reused appearance modules and procedural structure without any new AI task: record the source families as reuse and procedural. Reserve family route=hybrid for a family containing an actual new AI generation operation.

effective_policy.note: Narrow allowed_versions to the current user policy before planning. The G1 parameter below is an example, not a generic restriction.

asset_selection_note: First apply the current explicit user model policy; without one, select supplier/model/version and integer Lux faceCount 10000..300000 by actual visual needs, same-reference evidence and approved cost. The G1 parameter is an example. A user who defaults to G1 and permits Turbo only on explicit request must receive that behavior in plans and submissions. Preserve existing assets and historical parameters. G1 omits enablePbr; G1-Turbo omits customSize. Cost alternatives compare feasible AI suppliers/models/source-family and processing combinations at the approved visual target. Omit generation for reuse/procedural assets; preserve provenance. Show sourced estimates, wallet/currency caps, optional processing and retries before paid submission. Image-conditioned new mesh generation only. This draft grants no authorization.
native_visual_note: Non-mesh visual features may use asset_ids:[] and assembly_ids naming recipe units with native_realization. Each native owner binds kind (material/lighting/shader/vfx/environment), actual scene/node/material target, method and an actual H3 BOM/assembly evidence_image_id. This declares planned work and evidence, not executed scripts or visual acceptance. Native-only plans may have empty asset_proposals and visual-package bom, but keep actual BOM/assembly board images, annotations, composition ownership and all H4 feature/view checks. Every executable mesh binding still needs an asset proposal; precise_geometry features still need actual asset_ids. Do not use native ownership or skip to conceal mesh generation or omit critical effects. Classify each feature_kind as form/surface/light/atmosphere/motion. Form features always need asset_ids even when responsibility is environment; dominant form sources also need route_evaluation and procedural target-match evidence where applicable. AI/hybrid routes must bind real image-conditioned generation operations. See asset-routes.md.
